info.title: UMAI evaluation API
info.description:
Check content against your organization's guardrail before it goes to a model,
after the model answers, and around an agent's tool calls. One call per check; the answer is the
decision to act on.

Guides, limits and the error catalogue: the API documentation at `/docs/` on your UMAI address.

post.description:
Check one piece of content: a prompt (`PRE_LLM`), a model's answer
(`POST_LLM`), or an agent's tool call or tool result (`TOOL_INPUT`, `TOOL_OUTPUT`). Send the
conversation in `content.messages`; the guardrail decides which part it scans.

The answer is a decision: go on (`ALLOW`, `ALLOW_WITH_WARNINGS`), go on with the masked text in
`output_modifications.redacted_text` (`ALLOW_WITH_MODIFICATIONS`), or stop (`BLOCK`,
`STEP_UP_APPROVAL`). A key that belongs to an application is evaluated with the application's
guardrail; leave `bundle` out. The answer never contains the values it found.

Requires the `evaluate` scope.

prompt.summary: Check a prompt before it goes to a model

answer.summary: Check a model's answer before you show it

200.description: The decision. Every request that passed admission gets one, including when a part of the evaluation failed (`degraded: true`).

decision.reason: L0: TR_TCKN detected by policy Kimlik verileri v2

masked.summary: Allowed with an e-mail address masked

decision.reason: L0: EMAIL_ADDRESS detected by policy İletişim bilgileri v1

400.description: `tenant_required`: only for the self-hosted operator token.

401.description: `invalid_credential`: missing, unknown, expired or revoked key.

detail.detail: this key may not be used from this address

413.description: `input_too_large`: the content is longer than your limit. Nothing was evaluated and nothing was cut.

422.description: `invalid_request`: the body does not match the contract (where and how, never what it said); `bundle_required`: a key without an application must name the guardrail.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next attempt.

503.description: The service is starting; retry shortly.

name.title: Name
name.description: The action's name. Required for `TOOL_INPUT`, `MCP_REQUEST` and `MEMORY_WRITE`.

memory_scope.title: Memory Scope
memory_scope.description: The memory written to; required for `MEMORY_WRITE`.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key-value pairs; never interpreted.

artifact_type.title: Artifact Type
artifact_type.description: What the artifact is: a tool call, a tool result, ...

name.title: Name
name.description: The artifact's name, e.g. a file or tool name.

payload_summary.title: Payload Summary
payload_summary.description: A short text summary of the artifact; scanned like content.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key-value pairs; never interpreted.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Hash of that exact guardrail version.

version.title: Version
version.description: A published version; omitted: the active version. Not allowed with an application's key.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The conversation, oldest first. The guardrail decides which part is scanned; by default the last message.

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: The message being checked: the prompt (`LAST_USER_MESSAGE`) or the model's answer (`LAST_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE`).

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Tool calls, tool results, files or memory writes.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 language hint, e.g. `tr` or `en`; detected when absent.

action.description: What to do; see acting on a decision.

allowed.title: Allowed
allowed.description: `true` when the content may go on (perhaps masked).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Short explanation with entity types and ids, never the content.

decided_by.title: Decided By
decided_by.description: Which layer decided: `L0` data protection, `L1a` rules, `L1b` decision model, `pipeline` the guardrail's failure policy.

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: What produced the decision, strictest first.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description:
Admission and request refusals (evaluation API 0.6): the shape every 4xx shares;
413, 422 ``invalid_request`` and 429 ``quota_exceeded`` add fields (models below).

error.title: Error
error.description: Stable error code; see the error catalogue.

type.title: Type
type.description: Failure type, e.g. `L1B_TIMEOUT`; see the error catalogue.

contract_version.title: Contract Version
contract_version.description: Version of the request shape; send `0.12`.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Your id for this call; echoed in the answer.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: Leave it out: the key says whose request it is. If sent, it must be the key's organization.

bundle.description: The guardrail to evaluate against. Leave it out with an application's key: the application's guardrail applies.

phase.description: What is being checked; see the phases table.

subject.description: Who acts; facts the guardrail's policies can use.

action.description: The agent's action, for the agent phases.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout Ms
timeout_ms.description: Time budget for the whole evaluation in milliseconds; capped by the service.

bundle.description: The exact guardrail version that decided.

would_have.description: In `MONITOR` mode: what `ENFORCE` would have decided; `decision` is then `ALLOW`.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: A part of the evaluation failed and the guardrail's failure policy was applied; details in `errors`.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Entity types found with counts; never values.

output_modifications.description: The masked text, when the action is `ALLOW_WITH_MODIFICATIONS`.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Id of the recorded decision; quote it when you contact support.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Failures inside the evaluation; empty normally.

allow_model_calls.title: Allow Model Calls
allow_model_calls.description: `false` skips decision-model policies (faster); the answer is then `degraded` if one applied.

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: Include the per-layer `trace` in the answer.

InputTooLargeBody.title: InputTooLargeBody
InputTooLargeBody.description: HTTP 413 body (evaluation API 0.9): nothing was evaluated, nothing was truncated.

total.title: Total
total.description: Time spent in UMAI for this call, in milliseconds.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What matched: a data-protection policy (`l0_policy`), an exception (`l0_exception`), a rule (`l1a_rule`) or a decision-model policy (`l1b_policy`).

id.title: Id
id.description: The policy's, exception's or rule's id.

version.title: Version
version.description: The policy's version, when it has one.

action.description: The action this match asked for.

MatchedRule.title: MatchedRule
MatchedRule.description:
What produced (part of) a decision: a guardrail policy, the legacy per-type action, an
L0 exception, an L1a rule or an L1b decision policy (0.12). Ids and versions only, never
content.

redacted_text.title: Redacted Text
redacted_text.description: The scanned text with the listed entity types replaced by placeholders such as `<TR_TCKN_1>`; send this instead of the original.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: The entity types that were replaced.

QuotaExceededBody.title: QuotaExceededBody
QuotaExceededBody.description:
HTTP 429 body (evaluation API 0.13, ADR-0043): the month's requests are used; nothing was
evaluated.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Your id for the person; use a pseudonym, not an e-mail address.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Your id for the AI agent acting.

policy_id.title: Policy Id
policy_id.description: The policy that produced the tag.

rule_id.title: Rule Id
rule_id.description: The rule that produced the tag.

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Time the layer took, in milliseconds.

ValidationErrorBody.title: ValidationErrorBody
ValidationErrorBody.description: HTTP 422 body (evaluation API 0.8): the admission error shape plus `problems`.

ValidationProblem.title: ValidationProblem
ValidationProblem.description: Where a malformed request is malformed and how; never the value (0.8, ADR-0005).

UmaiKey.description: An API key from the console: `umai_<env>_<region>_<key_id>_<secret>`. Server side only; never in a browser or a mobile app.

tags.name: Evaluation
tags.description: Decide whether content may go on.

servers.description: Your UMAI address; the console shows it under API & SDKs.
